name: NINA / Warnung.bund.de civil protection warnings
summary: Keyless JSON feeds behind the German NINA warning app: MoWaS civil-protection alerts plus Katwarn, BIWAPP, DWD weather, flood and police warnings.
description: The warnung.bund.de api31 backend provides map-data lists of currently active warnings per channel (MoWaS, Katwarn, BIWAPP, DWD, LHP flood, police), a per-region dashboard keyed by 12-digit ARS regional code, full warning detail documents by id and the event-code catalogue. Titles are provided in several languages (de, en, ar, es, fr, pl, ru, tr).

rate_limit.summary: Not documented; responses use Cache-Control max-age=10.

endpoints.summary: Active MoWaS warnings (also katwarn, biwapp, dwd, lhp, police)
Warnings for one region by 12-digit ARS code
Full detail of one warning by id

license.name: Not stated on the pages fetched

agent_notes: The only documentation is the community OpenAPI spec (German, at nina.api.bund.dev). An empty array [] means no active warnings in that feed (the Katwarn, BIWAPP, DWD, LHP and police feeds and the dashboard for ARS 064350000000 were empty at check). ARS is the 12-digit Amtlicher Regionalschlüssel. Poll no faster than the 10 s cache.
caveats: Backend of the official app with community-written docs; the BBK does not publish an API contract, so paths can change.
No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header was sent; call from a server.
Active-warning lists were small (12 MoWaS entries at check).

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key.
